messages:
nina: quick heads-up: hotfix deploy v1.12.4-hot1 to roll back a route change for ff=llm-route-opt. will do 2% drop -> 0% if needed. change window 02:00-02:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: hotfix requested, artifacts route-api@sha256:hotfix789, feature=llm-route-opt OFF.
kevin: I'll monitor error-rate & latency. thresholds: error >1% sustained 3m or 95p latency >750ms.
sre: standing by. If we hit a regression, we'll execute emergency disable and drain cohorts.
pm-jon: note for customers: small rollback to previous routing to address intermittent memory spikes.
nina: executing initial 2% disable to test path. deploy-bot: feature llm-route-opt -> cohort=2pct-rollback-test disabled at 7055000015
kevin: 2% rollback applied. metrics: error down to 0.05%, latency normalized. good so far.
sre: ok to proceed to full rollback to 0% in 10m if stable.
nina: scheduling full disable at +10m. deploy-bot: scheduled disable to 0% at 7055000115
deploy-bot: feature llm-route-opt -> 0% applied.
kevin: metrics after 5m: errors 0.01%, latency baseline. Confirmed.
pm-jon: releasing short customer note: "rolled back routing change to mitigate memory spikes - no customer impact expected."
nina: closing thread. will file a short RCA if memory spikes reappear. :white_check_mark:
